recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Do not re-add or edit DeviceMetricObservation in core for FHIR-49923; if the remaining OID registry entry needs cleanup, handle it under a profile-removal or OID-maintenance issue rather than this maturity-level ticket.
issue_request: FHIR-49923 was an Applied/Persuasive R6 OO change request asking to correct a copy/paste structuredefinition-fmm value on the Device Metric Observation core profile after build tooling began respecting profile FMM extensions; the accepted resolution was to set the maturity to 0.
initial_application: Commit dfe2d4783f41a10d62b6d087c966db6568aa0f12, merged by HL7/fhir#3498 as 160f65e60e50c46e91a24c9c2f9e1501581aca62, changed source/observation/structuredefinition-profile-devicemetricobservation.xml from structuredefinition-fmm 5 to 0.
additional_context: The committers Zulip thread records that profile FMM values were becoming visible after a build-tooling fix, and OO minutes on 2025-04-01 record the FHIR-49923 decision to revert to zero with a 5-0-1 vote. Later commit 0c4fafcc6c9db057a5817f7db252ccecff100d55 removed the DeviceMetricObservation profile source and active Observation build/example references; the deleted profile already had FMM 0. Current fhir.ini has Observation active but no devicemetricobservation profile entry, and current source search finds no profile/build reference outside a leftover source/oids.ini registry line.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit is needed because the requested FMM value was applied while the profile existed, and the current core build has no in-scope DeviceMetricObservation profile maturity surface to correct.

related_jiras.note: Earlier OO FMM issue from the same core-profile tooling discussion; already represented on the combined branch by a separate audit commit and not decided here.
Same tooling discussion and Observation profile FMM family, but it covers vital-signs profiles and requires a separate profile-level review, so it was not decided here.
